page.overview:
Who is Chetney Pock O'Pea?

() is a gnomish blood hunter/rogue and member of Bells Hells. He is played by Travis Willingham.

Chetney is an elderly gnome who appears to be "a hundred-and-something" years old, with blue eyes, several scars, and a hooked nose that he says has been broken more than once. He stands about 3 foot 4 inches and has well-muscled arms. On his right arm is a tattoo of a crown and the letters "RTA", which stand for "Rexxentrum Toy Authority" (a mark required by his former union), though he tells people it stands for "Recognize The Alpha". Tufts of silvery-grey hair sprout from and over his ears from under a knitted cap with ear straps pulled down tight on his head; he is partially bald, and the remaining hair has gone completely silver as well. He originally wore a leather chest harness, pointy-toed boots, and woodworking tools around his waist. While aboard the Crimson Abyss, he acquired a flaming bell tattoo on his butt cheek. Just before the group traveled to Eiselcross, he bought a new leather fur-lined suit with some chainmail accents and a shoulder pauldron crafted from a piece of FCG's body, fingerless gloves, and a blue bandana embroidered "RTA", had his toolbelt turned into a bandolier, and hung the Harp of Valor from a leather strap at his waist.

In his werewolf form, Chetney becomes taller, and silvery-grey hair grows from his entire body. The transformation takes place quickly and results in his bones breaking and realigning and claws ripping through his existing fingernails. His voice is much deeper and gruffer as a werewolf.

According to Travis Willingham, in his youth Chetney was an attractive, tanned man, though with less muscular legs than his upper body. He had (more abundant) auburn hair, including groomed chest hair and a mustache.
